title: What If You Trained in SECRET for 90 Days for Your CRUSH?
tags: what if you trained for 90 days
description:
Your crush laughed when you slid down the rope in gym class. So you make a plan: 90 days, no gym, no money, no days off, and nobody can find out. Every night at 11 PM you hit your bedroom floor for push-ups, while a light in the window across the street goes off at exactly 11:04. On day 90 there's a rope, a bell, and the guy who dared you in front of everyone.

Two questions for the comments:
1) How many days could you train in secret without missing a single one?
2) Would you have told her about the training, or kept the secret until day 90?

Subscribe, and I'll see you on day 91.


Real facts in this episode:

• Push-ups can build as much muscle as the bench press when the effort is the same (Kikuchi & Nakazato, 2017, 8 weeks).
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29541130/

• Next-day soreness is not lactic acid. It comes from tiny tears in the muscle fibers and peaks 24 to 72 hours later.
https://www.houstonmethodist.org/blog/articles/2021/oct/is-lactic-acid-buildup-really-what-causes-muscle-soreness-after-a-workout/

• In the first weeks of training, most new strength comes from your nervous system, not from bigger muscles.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7892509/

• The biggest pulse of growth hormone comes shortly after you fall asleep, during the first deep sleep.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8627466/

• A new habit takes about 66 days on average to feel automatic (from 18 to 254), and missing one day does not ruin it (University College London).
https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2009/aug/how-long-does-it-take-form-habit

title: What If a Giganotosaurus Was Born Today?
description:
Lions are called the kings of the jungle. They don't even live there. So the jungle has no king... until today.

A Giganotosaurus hatches in Uganda: one of the biggest hunters that ever walked the Earth, born in a rainforest full of gorillas, next to a savanna full of lions, elephants and hippos. Watch it grow up, year after year, in today's Africa.

Which dinosaur should be born today next? Tell me in the comments!

title: What If You Woke Up 20,000 Years in the Future?
tags: what if you woke up 20000 years in the future
woke up 20000 years in the future
what if you woke up in the future
description:
What if you went to bed in 2026... and woke up twenty thousand years in the future? Your room came with you: the bed, the desk, your game controller, your mom's note on the desk. The world didn't. By breakfast there's glass around your room. By lunch, a line. You're not visiting the museum... you're in it.

Kids here are a head taller. Houses float. Nothing has laces, buttons or doorknobs. They can learn a new language before lunch, but they can't tie a shoe. So you tie yours, and thirty kids gasp. You whistle with two fingers, and the whole hall turns around. Rock, paper, scissors takes over the city. One handwritten name trades for a flying bike. They start calling you "Grandpa", the oldest kid in the world.

But everything you teach stops being yours. And at six o'clock every day, the old wing closes the old way: a stone gate that nothing can stop.

Would you teach the future everything you know?

A new What If story every week.

Real facts in this story:
- The oldest pottery ever found is about 20,000 years old: pieces from Xianrendong Cave, China (Wu et al., Science, 2012).
- A few words, like "mother", "fire" and "hand", may have lasted around 15,000 years across language families (Pagel et al., PNAS, 2013; a debated study).

This is a fictional story. Rumi, Nox and the museum are made-up.
Music: YouTube Audio Library.

title: What If You Were The Only Man On An Island of 100 Native American Girls?
description:
What if you were the only man on an island of 100 Native American women? 🏝️

You wake up on a mysterious tropical beach after your boat sinks during a violent storm. Before you can figure out where you are, dozens of warriors emerge from the jungle, pointing their spears directly at you. They take you to a hidden village where you’re told something unbelievable: you have exactly 30 days to earn the trust of 100 women. If every warrior raises her spear, you can stay. But if even one refuses, you must leave.

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine surviving on a remote island inhabited by a fictional Indigenous community with its own traditions, challenges, and secrets. From failing your first spear-throwing challenge to learning how to hunt, swim, and survive in the jungle, earning the villagers’ trust turns out to be much harder than expected.

At first, everyone sees you as a helpless outsider. But as the days pass, you begin helping the village, building useful inventions, and forming unexpected friendships. Your first vote might seem impossible to earn, but reaching all 100 would be an entirely different challenge.

Things become even more complicated when you discover mysterious writing left behind by a previous survivor, a secret emergency beacon, and a rescue ship approaching the island. What happened to the last man who washed ashore? Why does the village leader refuse to trust outsiders? And what happens when you’re forced to choose between returning home and protecting the people who saved you?

This 30-day survival adventure explores friendship, trust, mysterious island traditions, unexpected discoveries, and the difficult choices that come with being the only outsider in a hidden community. Could you earn all 100 spears before time runs out?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:

title: You Wake Up in 1950. The Wrong Side Won WW2
description:
You wake up in Berlin. It's 1950, and Germany won World War II. So why does something about this quiet morning feel so wrong?

What if Nazi Germany had actually won WW2? In this animated alternate history, you live it through the eyes of an ordinary German veteran, from a frozen field outside Moscow in December 1941 to the streets of a Berlin being rebuilt as Germania.

You'll relive the three moments that made this world possible, and the two decisions by one man that nearly destroyed it all:
• Britain, 1940: Dunkirk, Operation Sea Lion and the Battle of Britain
• Moscow, 1941: Operation Barbarossa and the detour to Kiev
• America, 1941: Pearl Harbor and the declaration of war that still confuses historians

Then you step outside and see the world this victory created, including the part of it nobody wants to look at, and find out whether an empire like this could ever have lasted.

Which one was the real turning point: Britain in 1940, Moscow in 1941, or America? Tell me in the comments.

title: What If You Were Stuck in a Time Loop Until You Beat Prime Usain Bolt?
description:
You blink, and you're standing on a running track with a number stuck to your shirt. It's Berlin, August 16th, 2009, the men's 100 meter final at the World Championships, and the man a few lanes over is Usain Bolt. The last time you sprinted anywhere, it was for a bus. You missed it.

He runs 9.58, a world record that still stands today. You cross the line about 15 seconds after the gun. Then you blink, and you're standing behind your blocks again. Every time the last runner finishes, the race starts over, and everyone forgets except you. Tiredness, injuries and hunger are wiped every time, you never get older, and your body keeps every bit of strength it builds. The only way out is to cross that line before him.

Could a normal person ever really beat him? Tell us in the comments

title: What If It Was -100°C for 10 Years?
description:
What if it was −100°C (−148°F) for 10 years — and you had to survive it? In this animated survival story, the polar vortex collapses, your city freezes in a single night, and the cold never leaves. How long would you last?

You're the super of an old apartment building. You drain the pipes before they burst, build a stove from a steel drum, and burn the building one apartment at a time. A young mine hoist operator named Iris walks toward your chimney smoke. Then one night, someone knocks on the heating pipe… and you knock back. What follows is ten years of extreme cold survival: a robbery that takes your fire, a nine-mile walk across a frozen city, and a salt mine 650 feet underground where the temperature never drops.

The never-ending winter is our "what if." Everything else is real science of cold survival:
• Why mercury thermometers stop working at −39°C
• Why ordinary steel shatters in arctic cold — and copper doesn't
• Why wet wood plugs a chimney with ice
• Why frozen food never spoils
• Why the frost line goes deeper into the ground every year
• Why a deep salt mine stays around +20°C (68°F) all year round

If you like winter survival stories, arctic survival, "how long would you survive" scenarios and animated what-if videos, this one is for you.

💬 If those five men had never taken your fire — when would you have walked away from it on your own? Tell me in the comments.

title: Imagine If Every Human Woke Up 1 cm Tall
description:
Tomorrow morning, you wake up 1 cm tall. So does everyone else on Earth.

Your blanket is a mountain range. Your phone is 25 meters long. And your cat… is now 40 meters tall.

You weigh less than a grain of rice. You can fall from any height and walk away. But a single drop of water can trap you forever. And by the end, all 8 billion humans fit inside seven rockets.

So how would humanity survive? Let's find out.

Got a crazier "Imagine if…"? Tell us in the comments 👇

title: What If You And Your Crush Were Alone On The Planet?
description:
What if you and your crush were the only people on an alien planet? 💘🪐 Scientists discover a mysterious new world that might support human life, and you're offered $100,000 to survive there for just 30 days. Sounds like easy money, right? But there's one unexpected twist: the person joining you is your crush! The same girl you've been too nervous to talk to for years. Now you're stuck together on an entire planet, millions of miles from everyone else.

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine spending 30 days alone with your crush on an unexplored alien planet: awkward conversations, breathtaking landscapes, mysterious creatures, and unexpected dangers. From exploring glowing forests and discovering strange alien wildlife to surviving deadly storms and repairing a damaged spacecraft, what starts as a simple mission quickly turns into an unforgettable adventure.

Would being completely alone with your crush finally give you the courage to confess your feelings? Or would constant arguments, embarrassing moments, and terrifying alien encounters make things even more complicated? With nobody else around, you'd have to learn to trust each other, work together, and survive whatever the mysterious planet throws at you.

This romantic sci-fi adventure explores survival, friendship, love, teamwork, and how extraordinary experiences can bring two people closer together. Between encountering a giant alien creature, facing dangerous storms, and watching two moons rise over an alien ocean, could thirty days on another planet turn an awkward crush into true love?

And when the mission finally ends, would you return to Earth with $100,000 and an unforgettable story—or something even more valuable?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:

🎀 What If You Turned Into a Girl?
